name: Bird Protection
summary: Small annual grants for projects focused on highly threatened or poorly known bird species worldwide. Applications are submitted by email as a single PDF in English or Swedish.

eligibility.rule: Project targets a CR, EN, EW or DD bird on the IUCN Red List

documents: Specification of how the requested money will be used
Long-term project plan and planned follow-up
List of other consulted donors or financial support sources

calls.label: Annual applications
calls.recurring: Applications are due by July 31 each year.

status.quote: Applications are accepted on a yearly basis.

recurring.quote: Applications for each year must be received by July 31st.

geography.quote: Since 1991 the Swedish Club300 has contributed more than USD600,000 to bird protection projects all around the world.

access.quote: Applications are only accepted as a single PDF file sent via e-mail to birdprotection@club300.se.

window.quote: Applications are accepted on a yearly basis.

amount.quote: The maximum annual amount granted to a single project is USD 5,000.

effort.quote: Applications for each year must be received by July 31st.

eligibility.quote: Only applications concerning projects aimed at birds listed as Critically Endangered (CR), Endangered (EN), Extinct in the Wild (EW) or Data Deficient (DD) on the IUCN Red List of threatened species are eligible for funding.

documents.quote: Name, physical address and e-mail of the applicant. A detailed description of the project, including information on which bird species will benefit from the project, and their IUNC Red List categorization. Geographic position of the project site, please include map if needed. Budget and an estimate of costs, which should include a detailed breakdown of expenses.

The amount requested from Club300 (in USD, EUR or SEK). A detailed specification on how the requested money will be used. A long term plan for the project, including planned follow-up etc. A list of other consulted donors, or sources of financial support.
A note on how Club300 will be acknowledged if we decide to support the project.
